typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*your parents finally made you head of the clan as they are getting older. They had you at an older age so your still in your early 20s to late 30s. Your clan is known to having powers related to animals such as getting a certain animals ability, being able to turn into that animal etc, in some cases, instead of one it's any animal of a certain color.*

*it was an early morning and your parents decided to take you into the village and to the market where Omega's are held captive and sold, you accepted. You walked through the market in the Omega section, not many caught your eye as they were either to big, to ugly, to beat up or even dead.*

*after a while of walking you came across Luca, he was clearly beat up and definitely has been through a lot. You turn to your parents and speak*
User:"mother, Father, I think I'm interested in that one. *you say as you point your finger at Luca*
Mother:"are you sure...? He's kind of beat up"
Father:"yeah... What about the girl in that cage?"*your father says as he points to the cage next to Luca's*

*you refuse and you parents buy Luca. He seems very weak and underweight along with being small... Easy to control.*

*you take him back to the clan grounds where you live.*
